front.text: Battlegrounds lie south (-z); the home coast/ocean is north (+z).

level_rule: Zone field (simple_map.lua zone_level_at): the range split in thirds, rising along z toward the front (or toward the zone middle for front zones); the start bands (L1 <= 100, L2 <= 150 nodes) override near start anchors.
name: Bannerbreak Mesa

protected.roads: road corridor = half width + 1 node beside the edge after Ruling 1 (today +3), +-5 vertical

quests.description: My crews haul siege timbers all day. The Warpack Hyenas laugh at them from the Bannerbreak Badlands, which lie in the northwest of Bannerbreak Mesa. Get out there in daylight and kill four. Anything with that much breath to spare can pull a rope or stop making noise.
quests.title: The Last Laugh

quests.description: I can train a fighter to face the Accord, but nobody fights well with a scorpion in their trousers. Hunt the War-Stinger Scorpions after dark in the Bannerbreak Badlands, which lie in the northwest of Bannerbreak Mesa. Kill four and bring me two Venom Sacs. My fighters have earned a night's sleep without armour.
quests.title: Inspect Your Bedroll

quests.description: Yarra Standardmender keeps Tornstandard Hold standing with patched banners and fighters too stubborn to fall. Report to her and say Drek sent you. I can spare a blade here; she needs every one she can get against the Accord.
quests.title: A Blade for Yarra

quests.description: Rumela Stormstep holds Thunderstep Watch in Thunderroot Wilds, where even the rain sounds ready for a fight. Go and speak with her; the trolls need blades in the jungle as much as we do on the mesa. We keep each other's banners flying.
quests.title: Where the Rain Fights Back

quests.description: My scouts watch for Accord patrols; the Tallgrass Tigers have learned to watch my scouts. Kill four of those tigers by day in the Bannerbreak Warplains, which lie in the east of Bannerbreak Mesa. It takes years to teach a fighter when to stay quiet. I will not spend those years feeding cats.
quests.title: A Scout Is Worth More

quests.description: Provisioner Rattle counts our stolen wagonloads as profit at the Bannerbreak Supply Camp east from here. Kill four Siege Goblins or Siege Goblin Slingers in any combination, and kill Rattle as well. Let him work out what a dead quartermaster earns.
quests.title: Rattle's Bad Arithmetic

quests.description: Night wagons need an escort through the Bannerbreak Warplains, which lie in the east of Bannerbreak Mesa, and the Warpack Hyenas have volunteered to eat it. Kill six there after dark and bring yourself back for payment. You can take the bounty again twenty minutes after collecting; keeping wagon crews alive is money well spent.
quests.title: Bounty: Teeth After Dark (repeatable)

quests.description: The Bannerbreak Redcut Flats lie in the southwest of Bannerbreak Mesa, and after dark the Trench Mummies still march there in armour from a war that used them up. Kill four and end their watch. Whatever banner they followed, no soldier owes it an eternity.
quests.title: A Soldier's Due

quests.description: The Entrenched Bandit Archers at the Sunderstrap Camp west from here keep putting arrows through supplies my fighters bled to bring here. Kill six and collect your bounty. Twenty minutes after payment you can take it again; I will keep paying as long as they keep drawing bows.
quests.title: Bounty: Arrows from Sunderstrap Camp (repeatable)

quests.description: I stitch the names of our fallen into our standards, and the Goblin Banner-Eater at the Bannerbreak Goblin Warcamp east from here eats them, poles and all. Gather a group and kill it; pride alone will not win that fight. Those names belong above our heads.
quests.title: Group: No Banner for Supper

quests.description: A road is for marching, and I will not have the dead setting our pace. Break five Mire-Cured Husks by day in the Causeway Floodmeadows, which lie in the southeast of The Broken Causeway. The Accord can count footprints; give the Throng something worth counting.
quests.title: Make the Mud Keep Them

quests.description: Warpack Hyenas have found our supply trail, and now the laughing starts before supper. Kill five by day in the Shattered Line Approaches, which lie in the southwest of The Shattered Line. I can mend a torn ration sack; I cannot sew the meat back into it.
quests.title: Nobody Laughs at Supper

quests.description: I patch enough holes in our soldiers without War-Stinger Scorpions punching fresh ones through their boots. Kill five after dark on the Shattered Line Bluffs, which lie in the northeast of The Shattered Line, and give the next patrol a fighting chance to march home.
quests.title: Mind the Boots

quests.description: Hear that sloshing after sundown? Fordwater Zombies are climbing through the Causeway Reedmire, which lies in the southeast of The Broken Causeway, and every patrol has to fight for dry footing. Kill five there at night; I want boots coming home with soldiers still in them.
quests.title: No Marching After Death

quests.description: This banner has survived arrows, rain, and a cook who mistook it for a towel. It deserves teeth of its own: kill four Tallgrass Tigers by day on the Shattered Line Bluffs, which lie in the northeast of The Shattered Line, and bring me two Siege Cat Claws. Let's give the Accord something new to stare at.
quests.title: A Standard with Claws

quests.description: Our scouts keep hearing paws where they ought to hear their own footsteps. Hunt down five Fenrunner Wolves at night in the Causeway Wraithwood, which lies in the east of The Broken Causeway. Save the boasting for when you can see what is listening.
quests.title: Teeth in the Dark

quests.description: The archers want venom, and for once their request comes with its own legs. War-Stinger Scorpions crawl at night over the Shattered Line Ramparts, which lie in the northeast of The Shattered Line; kill five and bring me two Scorch Venom. Try to keep the stings out of our side of the war.
quests.title: Stings for Our Side

quests.description: Toll-Taker Senn wants coin for every Throng boot that crosses his road. Find him at the Causeway Toll Camp southwest from here, kill four Aqueduct Bowmen there, and kill Senn. He can bill me for the trouble.
quests.title: Payment in Full

quests.description: Another lot of Causeway Brigands thinks robbing the Throng will pay. Kill five by day in the Causeway Wraithwood, which lies in the east of The Broken Causeway, and come back for your reward. You can take this bounty again twenty minutes after turning it in; apparently word travels slower than greed.
quests.title: Bounty: Bad Career Choices (repeatable)

quests.description: Standard-Bearer Ninepins waves that rag of his over the Shattered Line Breach southeast from here, and the dead still salute. Destroy four Siege Skeleton Raiders there at night and kill Ninepins. I have spent my life keeping standards upright; I'll enjoy hearing about this one falling.
quests.title: Let That Banner Fall

quests.description: You have put enough dents in the Causeway for me to send your name ahead. Speak with Orrel Hollowstep at Hollowarch Station in Blackwind Rise and tell him Drek Rampbinder sent you. He'll find work for hands like yours, even if he complains about the fingerprints.
quests.title: A Name Worth Sending

quests.description: War Construct Engine Nine is still grinding through the Shattered Line Siegecrest southeast from here, as if the war were a nail that needs more hammering. Gather a group and destroy it; one fighter will only add to the dents. I want all of you back to boast about this.
quests.title: Group: Break the War Machine

quests.description: Tallgrass Tigers care very little whose colours a soldier wears, which makes them a nuisance to everybody. Kill five by day on the Shattered Line Siegecrest, which lies in the northeast of The Shattered Line, and collect your reward from me. The bounty is available again twenty minutes after turn-in.
quests.title: Bounty: Stripes at the Front (repeatable)

quests.description: I could send Kezamba a banner listing what you have done, but I am running short of cloth. Go speak with Nalo Pathdrum in Kezamba; he sends fighters into The Skyglass Canopy. Tell him Yarra Standardmender vouches for you, and mind that you keep earning it.
quests.title: Send a Fighter, Save a Banner
